svg.title: Boolean matrix step: F4 and F5

cc:Work.dc:title: Boolean matrix step: F4 and F5
cc:Work.dc:description: One shared K_1 / 2^23 m=2 system, 22 Boolean variables, maximum degree 4. Matrix construction, reduction and readback; F5 includes its criterion.
